name: export_editor
description: Export a project for a video editor: writes <project>/export/<name> (editor)/ with <name>.xml (FCP7 XML for Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve), one ProRes 4444 alpha movie per overlay (graphics/<clip id>.mov), captions.mov and captions.srt. Cuts, crossfades, speed, placement and sound become real editor clips; overlays and captions are rendered once to transparent movies so they look exactly as in the Montaj render. What an editor cannot hold (moving zoom, loop, background removal, ducking) stays in Montaj and is marked on its clip; the result lists these in leftOut. Run async (montaj_step async:true) when the project has many overlays, and poll montaj_step_status. Re-exporting a name replaces its package. Takes a project, not a file input.

input.description: No file input: operates on a project (see the project param).

output.description: {dir, xml, files: [paths relative to dir], leftOut: [{clip, label}], warnings: [...], seconds}

params.name: project
params.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the package and its XML. Defaults to the project's name.

params.name: out
params.description: The folder to write the package to. Defaults to <project_dir>/export/<name> (editor)/. It is replaced whole on a re-export, but only when it is empty, new or a previous export package; any other folder or file is refused (out_exists).
